title: Leading a service work order in Ready for Review turns Technician on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, active, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to No, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2, whose only work is leading one service work order in Ready for Review, with no time recorded on it (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, Staff.
  2. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  3. Open Work Orders, Board View, at Trucks Hill 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A's row shows "Yes" in the Technician column.

Step 2:

  • Technician is on.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A has a column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-R1 (b): “(b) leads, has labor on, or is on a line that is not declined (with labor on it, added with Add Technician or through a schedule shift, or as the line's own technician) of, a service work order that is Approved, In Progress or Ready for Review;”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
